parts.label: Two pops
parts.prompt: After pushes 7, 8, 3, 1, 6 — which two numbers does pop() return?

fields.label: first pop()
fields.hint: Pop always takes the top — the last value pushed.

traps.hint: 7 is at the bottom of the stack, not the top.
1 is second-from-top; the first pop takes the top.

fields.label: second pop()
fields.hint: After 6 is gone, what sits on top?

traps.hint: Count from the top after the first pop.
